githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.3 adds native message search and a Command-K Quick Switch for moving between conversations, channels, servers, and Settings. It also improves reply workflows, server controls, distant-message navigation, loading performance, and network recovery.

## Message search

- Added native Command-F message search across the current server, all direct messages, or the current direct message.
- Added inline operator suggestions and filters for senders, channels, content types, mentions, dates, author types, and pinned messages.
- Added newest, oldest, and relevance sorting, paginated results, and exact jumps from a result to its message and surrounding context.

## Quick Switch and navigation

- Added a native Command-K Quick Switch for recent, draft, mention, and unread destinations, with search across people, direct messages, groups, text and voice channels, servers, and Settings.
- Improved Quick Switch and message-forwarding search ordering with workspace activity and destination eligibility.
- Restored each server's last-opened channel when switching between servers.

## Replies, history, and server controls

- Added Command-Up and Command-Down navigation through visible messages as reply context, stopping at the oldest and newest available messages.
- Redesigned the reply bar with the author's avatar and role color, a clearer cancel control, and a toggle for notifying the replied-to author.
- Fixed distant-message navigation so linked and searched messages load with contiguous history and accurate reply previews.
- Expanded server notification controls for everyone and role mentions, highlights, new events, and mobile push notifications.
- Made category collapse changes appear immediately with safe rollback, and prevented forum threads from appearing as top-level channels.
- Fixed self-mention highlighting, reply alignment, and modal background dimming.

## Performance and reliability

- Reduced startup, channel-switching, scrolling, server-rail, sidebar, timeline, media, and member-list stalls.
- Presented channel history before member hydration, bounded native member-list rendering to the visible viewport, and deferred animated-image work during active scrolling.
- Reused loaded credentials during account switching and published loading state incrementally to reduce avoidable waits.
- Added safe recovery from stalled REST connections without automatically replaying account mutations.
- Fixed loading-skeleton and search-toolbar transitions, Escape-key routing, and server-rail rebound.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.2...v0.1.3](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.2...v0.1.3)
discordAnnouncement:
**Message search and Command-K Quick Switch 🌸**

**Highlights**
- Search server and DM messages with Command-F, inline filters, sorting, pagination, and exact jumps to results
- Jump to DMs, channels, voice chats, servers, and Settings with Command-K Quick Switch
- Return to each server's last-opened channel when switching between servers
- Step through reply context with Command-Up or Command-Down, then choose whether to notify the author
- More complete server notification controls, instant category collapsing, and cleaner channel lists
- Faster startup and channel loading, smoother scrolling and media, and safer recovery from stalled connections
